goalText.title: Den Satz des Pythagoras geometrisch beweisen
goalText.description: Die lernende Person kann den Satz des Pythagoras für ein beliebiges rechtwinkliges Dreieck an einer geeigneten Zerlegungs- oder Ergänzungsfigur geometrisch beweisen und dabei die verwendeten Flächenbeziehungen und die Allgemeingültigkeit der Schlussfolgerung nachvollziehbar begründen.
goalText.descriptionEn: The learner can prove the Pythagorean theorem for an arbitrary right triangle using a suitable dissection or completion diagram and justify the area relations and the generality of the conclusion.

geometry: Outer square is approximately 588 by 588 px; four right-angle marks lie at its true corner angles.

Visually located inner vertices approximately (376,188),(711,439),(459,774),(125,524) give side lengths 418.60,419.20,417.20,419.40 px and successive angles 90.11,89.86,89.95,90.08 degrees. These differences are within the thick raster outline; the figure depicts a square without misleading distortion.

Each corner triangle has the same two leg lengths, approximately 251 and 336 px, in alternating orientation. Top a/b and left b/a labels agree with the actual subdivisions; c labels an inner hypotenuse edge and c² labels its area.
areaDerivation: Four congruent right triangles each have area ab/2. The outer square side is a+b and the inner square side is c.
(a+b)² = 4·ab/2 + c² expands to a²+2ab+b² = 2ab+c², hence c²=a²+b². Every displayed formula is correct.

For arbitrary positive a,b, adjacent acute triangle angles sum to 90 degrees, making every inner corner a right angle; congruent hypotenuses make all inner sides equal. This justifies the drawn square without assuming the Pythagorean theorem. The picture need not contain a complete written angle proof to serve as orientation.
goalFit: The decomposition supports the current goal of a geometric proof and explanation of the area relation and its generality. No numerical-special-case restriction is introduced.
styleAndReadability: Friendly light-blue/peach textured classroom illustration, clear navy text and orange conclusion; no visible generated text or geometry artifacts at original resolution.

At 360px, the square/triangle arrangement, a/b labels, area relations and c²=a²+b² remain discernible. Subtitle, small c edge label and bottom generality sentence are small and not comfortably readable; no claim that every annotation is comfortably legible without enlargement.

limitations: Prompt and reference provenance are read from the generator metadata; this independent reviewer did not invoke generation.
Two earlier rejected variants are documented by the generating agent; they were not independently viewed in this review and their defects are not attributed as new reviewer findings.

notes: This is a hash-bound candidate review, not an active import or current QA binding. Only this temporary review JSON was written.
360px inspection does not change the original-size acceptance; retain the explicit small-text limitation rather than claiming universal mobile readability.
